name: tradingview
description: Read-only TradingView OHLCV candle + 大道至简 indicator CLI on top of @mathieuc/tradingview v4, with a local SQLite cache: reads cached history, fetches only the missing older/newer bars, and stores new closed bars back. Bare names like USDT.D, US10Y, CNH1!, BTCUSD resolve automatically with unit/symbol_kind metadata. Only closed bars — the in-progress bar is never fetched.
